subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should idle/no-queue sessions with stale active embedded-run activity be force-recovered through active-abort after stuckSessionAbortMs once this branch is refreshed on current main?
rationale: The code path can unstick a real silent session outage, but it changes session-state and availability behavior by force-clearing active-run ownership from an idle diagnostic state, which needs explicit maintainer risk acceptance.

options.title: Refresh And Reconcile Recovery Policy
options.body: Resolve the dirty branch, preserve the current progress-age recovery behavior, compare against adjacent dispatch-liveness work, and rerun focused diagnostics validation before merge.

options.title: Accept Bounded Mitigation
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally land the idle active-abort mitigation after refresh if the six-minute default recovery window is the desired tradeoff for stale run bookkeeping.

options.title: Pause For Root-Cause Prevention
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers require a live Slack reproduction or a prevention fix for the handle leak before changing recovery behavior.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Reconcile Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty branch, preserve the current progress-age recovery behavior, compare against adjacent dispatch-liveness work, and rerun focused diagnostics validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: openperf has the closest recent recovery-path history and owns this branch, while the final policy choice should still be reviewed by maintainers familiar with session recovery.
